title: Chocolate Gateau
hookLine: France-inspired chocolate gateau with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Chocolate Gateau
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 180°C/350°F/Gas Mark 4. Grease and line the base of an 8 in round spring form cake tin with baking parchment. Keep {m52776_1}, {m52776_2}, {m52776_3}, and {m52776_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure plain chocolate first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Break the chocolate into a heatproof bowl and place over a saucepan of gently simmering water and stir until it melts. (or melt in the microwave for 2-3 mins stirring occasionally). Incorporate {m52776_5} and {m52776_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl and cream together with a wooden spoon until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in the eggs, adding a little flour if the mixture begins to curdle. Fold in the remaining flour with the cooled, melted chocolate and milk. Mix until smooth.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread the mixture into the cake tin and bake for 50-55 mins or until firm in the centre and a skewer comes out cleanly. Cool for 10 minutes, then turn out and cool completely.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
